node.title: A rank-nine nine-cell has a universal weighted component cap
node.closure: unique owner-point charging through disjoint plane petals
node.statement: Fix a rank-nine nine-subset B in a residual row n'=1048576+K', m'=67472+K'. If W_B counts affine-owner component eleven-subsets containing B over all assigned records, then W_B <= 981105*(m'-10)*n'. Each component extension has a unique owner point and at least one coordinate in that point's petal; one point owns at most 981105 records and the petals are disjoint. This is an incidence-weight cap, not a distinct-record cap.
